title.narrative: Increased capacity of Member States to set adequate wages and promote decent working time

description.narrative: The following are the major global deliverables and activities of the ILO in this policy area. (1) Publication of a new edition of the ILO Global Wage Report (2) Development of a better understanding of living wages by undertaking peer-reviewed research on concepts and estimations in that regard (3) Exploration of what the concept of minimum living income could mean for households in which at least one of the members is working. (4) Expansion of knowledge on wage and working time bargaining and how it can contribute to a fair share of productivity gains. (5) Expansion of the knowledge base on flexible working time arrangements and telework that ensure work–life balance and gender equality, and respect limits on working time and protection of workers.
